svg.title: primary TUI — help
svg.text: repotruck · devuser (auth: gh-cli) · preset: categorized · root: /tmp/repotruck-shots-ws · 11 repos
Cycle focus: sidebar, repository list, status panel
Move cursor; status panel focus scrolls the activity log
Jump the repository cursor to the first or last row
Page the repository cursor by one viewport
Select all filtered repositories (press again to clear)
Omnibar code search (text: prefix for line search)
Pin / unpin selected or highlighted repositories (Active Focus in AGENTS.md)
Switch right pane tab: [1] Activity · [2] Git Inspector · [3] Health & Doctor
Run Doctor auto-fix when the [3] Health tab is active
Cycle color theme live (default, light, contrast) and persist to settings
Open the clone modal (URL or owner/name)
Undo the last move or delete (restores the directory and its inventory entry)
Archive repo on GitHub to archived/
Open the worktree modal for the highlighted repository
Open repo in app (or Offline Mode)
Set alias (or retry on auth error)
Open sync preview; sidebar confirm; wizard advance
Quit (press twice in quick succession while a sync is running)
Dismiss the update toast (remembered once per version)
Open a page directly (letters listed in the Views section below)
Cycle to the previous / next page
Repository list: open the context menu for the cursor row
Up/Down or j/k scroll · Escape closes
[Tab] Focus [Space] Select [?] Help [q] Quit [:] Omnibar [/] Search [f] Health
